Name: Better Maru Character Sprite
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b][UPDATE][/b]

After nearly 5 years, I have updated this sprite sheet. Included are beach sprites as well as hospital sprites to match Maru's new look.

[b][OLD NEWS][/b]

Re-imaging Maru to have a more distinct look with better face shading and smaller eyes. I also recommend Maiz' [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/94]All About Maru[/url] mod! (I use the [url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/94-1-1458083743.png]Maru_Noglasses[/url] file; click for preview).
